caption: The drawing depicts a reddish-brown, round, shallow bowl with a glossy finish and a pale yellowish wavy line pattern on its inner surface. The bowl is shown in three views: a perspective view, a top-down view showing the swirling yellow design, and a side-profile view that includes measurements, indicating the diameter as 12 1/2 units and the height as 2 3/4 units. The rim of the bowl is slightly decorated, and the drawing is signed “J.Z. Lefevre” in the lower right corner within the border encompassing the main bowl illustration. The drawing is rendered on a plain, light-colored background, and the top-down view in the upper right is partly set upon a painted white patch.
title: Pie Plate
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
